item.title: [New] The Copilot desktop app's built-in browser on Windows and Mac gets enterprise policies for security, privacy, authentication, network and download control
item.description:
An in-app browser is a second browser on the endpoint; once BrowsingEnabled is turned on it must carry the same site, download and authentication restrictions as the corporate browser or it becomes a gap in web and data-loss controls.

Copilot · Keep BrowsingEnabled off unless there is a business need; if you enable it, mirror your Edge security, download and site-access policies in the new Copilot in-app browsing policies and test sign-in flows with a pilot group. Confirm in your own tenant.
